title: SKIM: Pruning Large Language Model Agents via Selective Knowledge Informed Masking
abstract: arXiv:2611.07558v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed under structured generation, where grammar constraints enforce output format at inference time. Whereas existing compression methods target unconstrained generation, we first identify a fundamental mismatch: under structured generation, grammar constraints reduce the model's output distribution to valid tokens, and the logits matter most at the small set of positions that decide the agent's action. Motivated by this finding, we propose SKIM (Selective Knowledge-Informed Masking), the first pruning and distillation framework for LLM agents under structured generation, with both stages guided by token role. translated_title: SKIM：通过选择性知识引导掩码对大语言模型智能体进行剪枝
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地在结构化生成场景下部署，其中语法约束在推理时强制执行输出格式。然而现有的压缩方法均针对无约束生成，我们首次发现了一个根本性的不匹配：在结构化生成下，语法约束会将模型的输出分布缩减至有效词元，而对数几率在决定智能体动作的少量关键位置上最为重要。受此发现启发，我们提出了SKIM（选择性知识引导掩码），这是首个面向结构化生成下大语言模型智能体的剪枝与蒸馏框架，其两个阶段均由词元角色引导。SKIM将词元位置划分为上下文、决策和格式三类，这一划分驱动了两个互补的方向：（1）类别感知的剪枝显著性分数，以保留与决策位置最相关的参数；（2）一种在线策略蒸馏目标……
tldr: 提出SKIM——首个面向结构化生成场景的大语言模型智能体剪枝与蒸馏框架，通过将词元位置划分为上下文、决策和格式三类，在剪枝与蒸馏两个阶段中优先保留与决策位置最相关的知识。
en_tdlr: SKIM is the first pruning and distillation framework for LLM agents under structured generation, which partitions token positions into context, decision, and format categories to guide category-aware pruning saliency scores and on-policy distillation toward preserving decision-critical knowledge.
